an8.21:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ
an8.21:1.2: tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhu āmantesi bhikkhavoti. bhadanteti te bhikkhu bhagavato paccassosuṃ. bhagavā etadavoca:
an8.21:1.3: aṭṭhahi bhikkhave, acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgataṃ uggaṃ gahapatiṃ vesālikaṃ dhārethāti.
an8.21:1.5: idaṃ vatvāna sugato uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
an8.21:2.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena uggassa gahapatino vesālikassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an8.21:2.2: atha kho uggo gahapati vesāliko yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho uggaṃ gahapatiṃ vesālikaṃ so bhikkhu etadavoca:
an8.21:3.1: aṭṭhahi kho tvaṃ gahapati, acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato bhagavatā vyākato.
an8.21:3.2: katame te gahapati, aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutā dhammā yehi tvaṃ samannāgato bhagavatā vyākatoti.
an8.21:3.4: katamehi aṭṭhahi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato bhagavatā vyākato.
an8.21:3.5: api ca bhante, ye me aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutā dhammā saṃvijjanti
an8.21:3.7: evaṃ gahapatīti kho so bhikkhu uggassa gahapatino vesālikassa paccassosi.
an8.21:3.9: yadāhaṃ bhante, bhagavantaṃ paṭhamaṃ dūratova addasaṃ
an8.21:3.10: sahadassaneneva me bhante bhagavato cittaṃ pasīdi.
an8.21:3.11: ayaṃ kho me bhante paṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.21:4.1: so kho ahaṃ bhante, pasannacitto bhagavantaṃ payirupāsiṃ.
an8.21:4.2: tassa me bhagavā ānupubbīkathaṃ kathesi, seyyathīdaṃ:dānakathaṃ
an8.21:4.3: sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṅkilesaṃ nekkhamme ca ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
an8.21:4.4: yadā maṃ bhagavā aññāsi kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā, taṃ pakāsesi,
an8.21:4.6: seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadeva rajanaṃ patigaṇheyya,
an8.21:4.7: evameva kho me tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi,
an8.21:4.8: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhammanti.
an8.21:4.9: so kho ahaṃ bhante, diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthusāsane
an8.21:4.10: tattheva buddhañca dhammañca saṅghañca saraṇaṃ agamāsiṃ. brahmacariyapañcamāni ca sikkhāpadāni samādiyiṃ.
an8.21:4.11: ayaṃ kho me bhante, dutiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.21:5.1: tassa mayhaṃ bhante, catasso komāriyo pajāpatiyo ahesuṃ.
an8.21:5.2: atha khvāhaṃ bhante, yena tā pajāpatiyo tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā tā pajāpatiyo etadavocaṃ:
an8.21:5.3: mayā kho bhaginiyo brahmacariyapañcamāni sikkhāpadāni samādinnāni.
an8.21:5.4: yā icchati sā idheva bhoge ca bhuñjatu! puññāni ca karotu! sakāni vā ñātikulāni gacchatu!
an8.21:5.5: hoti vā pana purisādhippāyā, kassa vo dammīti.
an8.21:5.6: evaṃ vutte sā bhante jeṭṭhā pajāpatī maṃ etadavoca:
an8.21:5.8: atha khvāhaṃ bhante, taṃ purisaṃ pakkosāpetvā vāmena hatthena pajāpatiṃ gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena bhiṅkāraṃ gahetvā tassa purisassa onojesiṃ.
an8.21:5.9: komāriṃ kho panāhaṃ bhante, dāraṃ pariccajanno nābhijānāmi cittassa aññathattaṃ.
an8.21:5.10: ayaṃ kho me bhante, tatiyo acchariyo dhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.21:6.1: saṃvijjanti kho pana me bhante, kule bhogā.
an8.21:6.2: te ca kho appaṭivibhattā sīlavantehi kalyāṇadhammehi.
an8.21:6.3: ayaṃ kho me bhante, catuttho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.21:7.1: yaṃ kho pana ahaṃ bhante, bhikkhuṃ payirupāsāmi,
an8.21:7.3: ayaṃ kho me bhante, pañcamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.21:8.1: so ce me bhante, āyasmā dhammaṃ deseti
an8.21:8.3: no ce me so āyasmā dhammaṃ deseti ahamassa dhammaṃ desemi.
an8.21:8.4: ayaṃ kho me bhante, chaṭṭho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.21:9.1: anacchariyaṃ kho pana maṃ bhante, devatā upasaṅkamitvā ārocenti:
an8.21:9.3: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhante, tā devatā evaṃ vadāmi:
an8.21:9.4: vadeyyātha vā evaṃ kho tumhe devatā no vā vadeyyātha, atha kho svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammoti,
an8.21:9.5: na kho panāhaṃ bhante, abhijānāmi tatonidānaṃ cittassa uṇṇatiṃ,
an8.21:9.6: maṃ vā devatā upasaṅkamanti ahaṃ vā devatāhi sallapāmīti.
an8.21:9.7: ayaṃ kho me bhante, sattamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.21:10.1: yānimāni bhante, bhagavatā desitāni pañcorambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni, nāhaṃ tesaṃ kiñci attani appahīnaṃ samanupassāmīti.
an8.21:10.2: ayaṃ kho me bhante, aṭṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.21:11.1: ime kho bhante, aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutā dhammā saṃvijjanti.
an8.21:11.3: katamehipahaṃ aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato bhagavatā vyākatoti.
an8.21:12.1: atha kho so bhikkhu uggassa gahapatino vesālikassa nivesane piṇḍapātaṃ gahetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
an8.21:12.2: atha kho so bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an8.21:12.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu yāvatako ahosi uggena gahapatinā vesālikena saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo, taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesi.
an8.21:13.2: yathā taṃ uggo gahapati vesāliko sammā vyākaramāno vyākareyya imeheva bhikkhu, aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato uggo gahapati vesāliko mayā byākato.
an8.21:13.3: imehi ca pana bhikkhu, acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgataṃ uggaṃ gahapatiṃ vesālikaṃ dhārethāti.
